cover.title: 5 niche things that will make you dangerously good at naming

inner.title: the .si gold rush
inner.body: register.si went from 241,459 names on october 1 to 378,745 on october 11. hostinger says only about 3% of its .si sales were explicitly ai.

inner.title: nobody ordered your rename
inner.body: executive order 14434 tells federal agencies to say si, not private companies. altman says openai has no plans to rename.

inner.title: what renames actually cost
inner.body: google says moving a small site takes a few weeks, with redirects kept a year or more. podcasts, posts and ai answers that name you can't be redirected.

inner.title: the .ai tax
inner.body: a .ai costs $82.70 a year at porkbun, with a two-year minimum. that's $165.40 up front, after the registry raised wholesale prices in march.

inner.title: the $11 guard dog
inner.body: a .si costs about $11.54 a year and works as a redirect. google reads .si as slovenia, so a main site there targets the wrong country.

keep the name.
